# telnyx_access_ip_ranges (Data Source)

Lists access ip ranges, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_access_ip_range`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_cidr_block` (String)
- `filter_created_at` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
